gcs.population: TBIMS Form 1, age >= 16 with valid age (n=17744)

sentinel.note: 77/88/99 are non-score codes (untestable / not applicable / unknown per the TBIMS dictionary convention); together they are 41% of records and are excluded from every severity band

gcs.note: Distribution of Glasgow Coma Scale totals in the cohort.

networkCohort.label: Mild TBI, 5-year follow-up, answered the comorbidity module (the network cohort)

followUp.note: Form 2 holds one record per person per scheduled follow-up (records exist for people lost to follow-up too). The NHANES-style comorbidity questions were only asked from form version 15.3/16 (interviews 2017-2019), so only a few hundred people per follow-up year have comorbidity data. IntStatus == 1 is taken to mean "followed/interviewed".

prevalence.definition: any = yes/(yes+no); afterInjury = yes with onset at or after the injury (onset codes 2-3) over all respondents (Frontiers 2023 definition); beforeInjury = onset code 1. 95% Wilson intervals. Cells with fewer than 11 people (or fewer than 11 in the complement) are suppressed.

frontiersComparison.note: Sudhakar et al. 2023 (Frontiers) Table 1 uses the same definition on a cohort that keeps the two age codes (n = 228). Prevalences here follow that definition. Published percentages are quoted only where the published count is >= 11.

_meta.source: TBIMS National Database public-use files (Form 1 and Form 2, release 2021-10-06), Traumatic Brain Injury Model Systems Program; used under the TBIMS NDSC data-use agreement by Kaustav Mehta. Analysis code: CoMorb_Updated.ipynb (2022) reimplemented in Python 3 / pandas / networkx 3.7.
_meta.suppression: Counts below 11 are replaced by null (and their percentages and confidence intervals are withheld); where a count is shown its complement is also >= 11. No row-level data, identifiers or dates.
_meta.processing: Cohort = TBIMS Form 1 records with AGEnoPHI >= 16 (age codes 777 and 999 dropped) and the mild-TBI band used in the analysis. Network cohort = those whose 5-year Form 2 record answered the comorbidity module. Sex code 1 = female, 2 = male (consistent with the ~74% male TBIMS population and with the Frontiers 2023 female/male Ns). Cause of injury grouped from Form 1 "Cause" codes: 1-5 vehicle, 21 pedestrian, 19 fall, 10-12 violence, 13-18 sports, 20 struck by object, others/unknown (77, 99, 22) as other/unknown.
